## Medium LaTeX Editor

[Live]{.sw-badge .live}
:::

I got fed up with Medium's lack of LaTeX support — and with the third-party tools around it — so I built my own. If you publish mathematical content on Medium, you might find this useful.

::: sw-meta
*Type* — Web application \| *Stack* — HTML / CSS / JavaScript

## StatsLearnR

[In progress]{.sw-badge .wip}
:::

An interactive Shiny application for teaching the fundamentals of statistics — sampling, estimation, and inference explored by moving the parts rather than reading about them. Built for the students I keep meeting who can run the test but can't say what it assumes.

::: sw-meta
*Type* — R package & Shiny app \| *Stack* — R / Shiny
:::

[In development — I'll post here and to the newsletter when there's something to try.]{.sw-note}
